'Frost is permitted on chrome and scene overlays only — --vt-frost-bg /
--vt-frost-border, both color-mix over scene surfaces, so the effect degrades
to a solid panel wherever backdrop-filter is unsupported. Evidence surfaces
stay solid: no frost on a proof row, artifact, receipt, or any surface a

WHY THIS FILE EXISTS. The first version of the glass gate enforced the PRE-A-1
blanket ban and cited 'Glass treatment: None' — a row superseded the day before it
was written. It failed lawful A-1 frost on the scene island (148 vs a baseline of
147), and that work was withheld rather than the baseline widened. A guard citing
repealed law converts permitted work into blocked work, silently.
Files here are chrome or scene overlays, where frost is LAWFUL. They are exempt
from the tail count but must still carry a degradation path (color-mix or
@supports) — that is A-1's own condition, not a preference.
The list is explicit rather than pattern-matched. Guessing a surface's class from
its filename is how a proof row ends up frosted.
